sylvie (docs): Noticed a docs vs API mismatch on POST /v1/generate examples: our OpenAPI shows max_tokens as "integer (required)" but examples and SDKs treat it as optional and use max_new_tokens in some snippets. Customers are confused. I'm opening a PR to unify docs and add a migration note.
omar (api): Thanks. The runtime accepts both max_tokens (legacy) and max_new_tokens (preferred). We intended to standardize on max_new_tokens to avoid ambiguity across streaming and non-streaming. Plan: update OpenAPI to list both (oneOf) and mark max_tokens deprecated (x-deprecated:true). Add example using max_new_tokens.
rachel (sdk-go): Go SDK currently maps max_new_tokens->MaxNewTokens but our generated OpenAPI client expects max_tokens. We'll add a mapping in the SDK layer to accept either param and normalise to max_new_tokens. Also will add a unit test using the new example.
qa-bot: Please include a small "Common gotcha" box in docs: if you used the old example with max_tokens and saw truncation, switch to max_new_tokens and bump prompt_tokens budget.
ci-bot: docs preview build queued. sylvie (docs): Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7890 (WIP) - changes: update API ref examples to use max_new_tokens, add deprecation note for max_tokens, add JS/Go/Python snippets showing both fields for clarity, and a migration section.
omar (api): When you update OpenAPI, add x-compatibility: true and an example showing both fields present (server will prefer max_new_tokens). Coordinate with SDK teams for same-day deploy.
rachel (sdk-go): Will aim to release the SDK patch the same day as docs merge; will include changelog entry "accepts max_new_tokens and will map legacy max_tokens for backwards compat".
sylvie (docs): Great. I'll wait for SDK PR links before merging; tagging @rachel for review. ci-bot: preview passed: https://deploy-preview-7890--docs.redwood.ai/ (CI: ✔)
sylvie (docs): After merge I'll post a short note in #product and #support with the migration snippet.
